# Salford Hongkongers CIC

> Community Interest Company (Companies House no. 13877472) founded in January 2022 by Hongkongers in Salford, Greater Manchester. It helps new arrivals from Hong Kong settle in the UK, keeps Hong Kong culture alive and builds mutual support. Website content is in Traditional Chinese (Cantonese) and English.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://salfordhongkongers.co.uk/): who we are, mission, events, contact
- [Community information](https://salfordhongkongers.co.uk/info/): Salford council notices, local events, helplines, jobs, housing, education
- [Support us](https://salfordhongkongers.co.uk/donate.html): volunteering, partnerships, donations
- [Contact](https://salfordhongkongers.co.uk/forms.html): enquiries and sign-up forms

## 友愛冰室 Yau Oi Cafe
- [Yau Oi Cafe](https://salfordhongkongers.co.uk/yauoicafe/): Hong Kong-style café run by CIC volunteers at The Angel Centre, 1 St Philip's Place, Salford M3 6FA. Open Friday to Sunday, 10:00–14:00 (2pm last order).
- [Menu](https://salfordhongkongers.co.uk/yauoicafe/menu/): all-day breakfast sets, bakery, sandwiches, drinks, prices and allergens
